s0: Meet Agentic Excalidraw: a whiteboard you share with your AI agent.
s1: Ask for a diagram in plain words.
s2: It arrives right in the chat, as a drawing you can edit.
s4: Then ask the agent to build on what you drew. Your shapes stay exactly where you left them.
s5: It goes well beyond flowcharts: here is a financial report, connected number by number.
s6: A research paper, from problem to evidence, on one page.
s7: Or a whole book. The agent lays it out in passes while you watch.
s8: Zoom in, and every chapter is there.
s9: Every drawing also lives in a library, one click away in the sidebar.
s10: Open any of them full page, and keep working.
s11: Light or dark, English or Chinese.
s12: Local files, autosave, no silent overwrites. Try it in Codex.
